description: Standard aggregate data products derivable from anonymised INHERIT documents

dimensions.label: Estate value by jurisdiction
dimensions.description: Average estate value by jurisdiction, using value brackets to prevent re-identification of high-value estates

dimensions.label: Asset category distribution by region
dimensions.description: Distribution of asset categories across regions, showing which asset types are most prevalent in each jurisdiction

dimensions.label: Common estate plan gaps
dimensions.description: Most common gaps in estate plans, derived from completeness scoring and missing field analysis
anonymisationApplied: Analysis based on structural completeness only, not content

dimensions.label: Forced heirship prevalence
dimensions.description: Proportion of estates with forced heirship constraints, broken down by jurisdiction and legal tradition

dimensions.label: Sacred asset prevalence by region
dimensions.description: Prevalence of sacred or ceremonial assets by region, supporting cultural sensitivity analysis

dimensions.label: Cross-border estates
dimensions.description: Proportion of estates with assets in multiple jurisdictions, indicating complexity of cross-border estate planning

dimensions.label: Will type distribution by jurisdiction
dimensions.description: Distribution of will types (e.g. simple, mirror, mutual, holographic) across jurisdictions

dimensions.label: Professional vs family executor rate
dimensions.description: Rate of professional versus family executors by jurisdiction, indicating market penetration of professional estate services

dimensions.label: Religious consideration prevalence
dimensions.description: Estates with religious considerations broken down by tradition, showing how faith influences estate planning

dimensions.label: Communal ownership prevalence by region
dimensions.description: Assets with communal ownership arrangements by region, highlighting the importance of collective land and resource rights

dimensions.label: Export-restricted assets by category and jurisdiction
dimensions.description: Prevalence of export-restricted assets by category and jurisdiction, relevant for cross-border estate transfers

dimensions.label: Trending collectible categories by region
dimensions.description: Most catalogued collectible categories by region, indicating which types of collectible assets are most commonly included in estate plans
